start.title: [TODO:ru] A New Star
start.text:
[TODO:ru] A bright star rises in the east.
It shines unlike any other.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] A king is born in Judea.
[TODO:ru] It is a sign of joy, not dread.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Look Again
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The star will not be hidden.
It calls you onward.

fear_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Take Heart
fear_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] This light brings hope.
Follow where it leads.

journey.title: [TODO:ru] The Long Road
journey.text:
[TODO:ru] You ride west across endless dunes.
The star moves before you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Turn back, the road is hard

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] A king must dwell with kings.

turn_back_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Forward Still
turn_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The promise lies ahead.
Do not turn from it now.

herod.title: [TODO:ru] Before Herod
herod.text:
[TODO:ru] "Where is the newborn King of the Jews?"
Herod's eyes grow cold.

loyalty_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] One True King
loyalty_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Herod is not the One you seek.
Keep your eyes on the star.

bethlehem.title: [TODO:ru] The Star Stops
bethlehem.text:
[TODO:ru] The star halts above a humble house.
Here, the King is found.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Doubt — this cannot be the place

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your hand trembles at the door.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Trust the Sign
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The star itself has led you here.
Believe and enter.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step inside the warm light.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Enter Now
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Do not delay before the King.
He waits within.

worship.title: [TODO:ru] Gold, Frankincense, Myrrh
worship.text:
[TODO:ru] The child meets your eyes.
You kneel and open your treasures.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Keep the finest gifts for yourself
[TODO:ru] Offer all three gifts to the child
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your heart bows with the gifts.

greed_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Give All
greed_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He is the King of kings.
Hold nothing back.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Offer all three gifts to the child
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You place each gift before him.

dream.title: [TODO:ru] A Warning in Sleep
dream.text:
[TODO:ru] In a dream you are warned:
"Do not return to Herod."

betray_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Obey the Dream
betray_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Herod plots against the child.
Do not lead him to the King.

stay_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Go Home
stay_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Your task here is fulfilled.
Return by another way.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You set out at first light.

return.title: [TODO:ru] Another Road
return.text:
[TODO:ru] You ride east as dawn breaks.
You have seen the King.
